author: tersec
content:
<@&688101493978562687> `nimbus-erigon-1` and `nimbus-erigon-2` on `devnet-8` are both missing blocks because they're opt-synced, i.e. the CL (Nimbus) is synced, but the EL is returning either `SYNCING` or `ACCEPTED`, therefore Nimbus isn't validating, e.g.,
```
INF 2026-10-13 00:28:11.997+00:00 Slot start                                 topics="beacnde" slot=435741 epoch=13616 sync="synced [opt]" peers=47 head=904eeceb:435740 finalized=13614:c62e71e8 delay=443us520ns
```
